grammar.summary: 本课学习过去将来时 would do 与意愿表达。

points.title: 过去将来时 would do
points.explanation: 从过去视角看将来：The dentist asked if he wanted to tell him something. would do 表过去将来。

examples.en: The dentist could not find anything wrong with his teeth.
examples.cn: 牙医没发现他的牙有什么问题。

points.title: in answer to 表"作为回应"
points.explanation: in answer to + 名词 = 作为对……的回答，书面语。

examples.en: In answer to these questions, the patient said nothing.
examples.cn: 病人对这些问题的回答是一言不发。
